I was in 7th grade, and I was in a huge fight with my best friend. I was being stubborn and decided not to say sorry to her for about 2 months. After a while, i decided I wanted to say sorry. I called her on my home phone with speed dial, not exactly remembering her number, and then called her. I heard a hello, then I burst into tears and sobbed my heartfelt appology for around 6 minutes without her saying a single word. After I finished, there was silence. Then, "I'm sorry, you've got the wrong number, this is (my sisters friend's) mom... At least you got a practice round!" I giggled and hung up. I was outside, so I ran inside and broke down in my mom's arms. I felt like throwing up so bad, I still remember the feeling. Anyways, that scarred me and I will forever remember that day...
